scope: Exploratory visual state brackets after six-frame review, first dense pass at stride3; interval boundaries are not exact event timestamps. Adult on right foreground only.

events.name: 双手明显离开膝部并向面罩靠拢
events.meaning: last sampled ambiguous/transition state through first sampled clear raised-hands state; blur prevents exact onset

events.name: 双手明确握住黄色面罩部分
events.meaning: near-contact through clearly held state; exact finger contact partly occluded

events.name: 解剖右手举带到上胸/脸侧区域
events.meaning: strap and hand motion observed, broad bracket covers height and occlusion ambiguity

events.name: 最后右手带子举至额前
events.meaning: final pose state present in all; no precise arrival-time claim

interpretation: First reaching/grasping phase appears later in ordinary edit; guided phase closer to source. Final forehead pose converges across all three, so the discrepancy varies through the action sequence. MF is separately almost equal.
precision_warning: Each interval is an exploratory visual bracket; do not report derived interval as a validated exact lag or independent benchmark sample.
